svg.aria-label: Left: on a 20-feature lasso, the objective gap of FISTA falls fastest, ISTA next, while the subgradient method stalls. Right: the trajectory of a weight whose lasso value is zero: ISTA sets it to exactly zero after a few steps while the subgradient method keeps jittering around zero
